6540.title: Quadratic file-edit history reconstruction blocks the event loop
6540.rootCauseOneLine: File-change lifecycle updates repeatedly scan and copy the growing projection history, creating quadratic synchronous work.

prReviews.verdict: CLOSED — metadata and static diff only
prReviews.topFinding: Broader eight-file change was not executed or approved.

6540.proposedFix: Append new call rows and skip replacement when existing row identities and order are unchanged; preserve structural replacement fallback.
6540.caveats: Synthetic Linux/Node 22 projection and timer reproduction; live UI/HTTP latency, macOS timings, scheduler and database contributions were not measured.
